title: Choosing the store: access pattern, consistency, scale and price

videos.script: Twenty six lessons, and each one taught a store or a way to move data between stores. This one teaches how to choose. {{stores}} The wrong way is to start from the store you like. The right way starts from the workload, with six questions asked in order. {{questions}} How is the data read and written? How fast must an answer come? Must it see the latest write? How big does it grow? Who will operate it? And only then, what does it cost? {{order}} The first question splits the stores of this course into seven branches, and you will see them on one tree. {{tree}} Then Quitanda's workloads, from the checkout to the archive, each given its store with the reason. {{workloads}} Then one screen of the app, priced in three stores. One costs about twenty dollars a month. One costs fifteen times that. One is as dear and far too slow to use. {{priced}} And four ways teams choose wrong, each of which works perfectly on the first day. {{end}}
